chunks.page_content: The contemporary government of Northern Ireland was abolished in 1972. The office of Prime Minister of Northern Ireland was abolished in 1972. The Prime Minister of Northern Ireland was the head of the Government of Northern Ireland between 1921 and 1972. No office of Prime Minister of Northern Ireland was provided for in the Government of Ireland Act 1920. The office-holder of the Prime Minister of Northern Ireland assumed the title "Prime Minister" to draw parallels with the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.
